title: myriopteris tomentosa
intro: Myriopteris tomentosa, commonly known as woolly fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Myriopteris tomentosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting the immune system. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems.
